text: A local MLA from Hubli demands a 15% cut of our Bellary mining operations. Pay him?
Rival don Shankar Gouda from Koppal is moving iron ore trucks through our territory. Let them pass... for a toll?
Three of your lieutenants want a salary hike. They're your best men. Agree?
A desperate widow pleads to return her husband's confiscated truck. It's worth ₹4 lakh. Release it?
Your informant says a DSP is building a case against you. You can bribe him for ₹10 lakh. Do it?
A rival gang firebombed our warehouse in Gadag. The crew demands retaliation. Authorize the strike?
A smooth-talking journalist offers a 'favorable profile' in exchange for exclusive access. Grant it?
Your chief explosives handler wants out — he has a family. Let him leave cleanly with a payout?
A Dharwad contractor is offering a huge public works tender — it requires setting up a shell company. Take it?
A street boy who ran errands for you was arrested. His mother begs you to use your connections to free him. Help?
The Bidar syndicate proposes a shared smuggling route to Goa. A powerful alliance, but you lose exclusivity. Partner up?
A corrupt municipality officer wants a fixed monthly payoff to look away from your stone quarry. Pay the 'rent'?
One of your top men is skimming from the collections. You can make an example of him, publicly. Do it?
A young police sub-inspector wants to secretly become your mole. The risk is high. Recruit him?
The festival of Dasara is here. The locals expect your 'donation' for the celebrations. Be generous this year?
